subject: Discovery recap, stakeholder gaps & alignment action plan for FolkHealth POC
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Barnes <emma.barnes@folkhealth.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@folkhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-11T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap + draft alignment action plan for FolkHealth POC

Hi Emma / Liam —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and a first-pass action plan attached so we can align on milestones and owners. Key takeaways: 

- Primary use case: summarize clinical notes for care teams (30–50M tokens/month estimated in steady state).
- Decision criteria: accuracy of clinical extraction, latency under 400ms p50 for short prompts, and SOC2 + data residency in US required.
- Economic buyer: Emma (confirmed in call), Legal/Procurement and Security to vet contracts and evidence.

What I’m proposing next (attached: FolkHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx):
1) By 4/18 — Security packet (SOC2 one-pager, data residency matrix) to procurement/security.
2) By 4/25 — MVP scoping call with engineering + product to lock success criteria.
3) By 5/02 — Procurement window: initial SOW terms + redlines.

Please: 
- Confirm the procurement + legal contacts (I did not have the correct procurement email on the call).
- Confirm the date windows above or propose alternatives.

Attachments: FolkHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft)

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0132

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@folkhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Barnes <emma.barnes@folkhealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T09:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + draft alignment action plan for FolkHealth POC

Thanks Soojin — good summary. Quick clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement contact: procurement@folkhealth.com (we use a central queue; I’ll also ask our legal lead to confirm).
- Security contact: Aisha Khan is our VP Product who owns vendor security and will need the SOC2 + data residency answers. I’ve copied her below when she’s back in.

Two asks: 
- Can you confirm whether Redwood supports in-region (US-East) hosting and an option for isolated VPC deployment for the POC?
- We will want a short SOC2 evidence packet (one-pager + contact to chat) for our security team to triage.

I’ll confirm if Emma is the formal econ buyer (as she stated on the call), but she has visibility.

Thanks,
Liam
Director, Integrations
FolkHealth
liam.oconnor@folkhealth.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@folkhealth.com>, Emma Barnes <emma.barnes@folkhealth.com>, procurement@folkhealth.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-13T10:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + draft alignment action plan for FolkHealth POC

Appreciate the quick reply, Liam. Short answers and next steps below.

- Hosting / residency: Redwood supports US-East hosting and we can provision a dedicated VPC for the POC. See attached service-residency-matrix.csv for options.
- SOC2 packet: attaching SOC2-OnePager.pdf and I’ll have our security rep available for a 20–30 minute call if your team wants to triage specifics.

Updated asks from our side (I’ve also pushed an updated MAP tab in the attached workbook):
- Procurement/legal: please share the primary contract reviewer and preferred redline turnaround (typical is 3–5 business days once we receive redlines).
- Security: please send any minimum bar checklist you want us to address on the security call.
- Econ buyer confirmation: Emma, can you confirm you’re the decision owner and whether VP Product (Aisha Khan) should be invited to the next scoping?

Attachments: FolkHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated), SOC2-OnePager.pdf, service-residency-matrix.csv

I’ve put proposed calendar slots for the MVP scoping call the week of 4/25 in the MAP. If those work, we’ll lock one and invite the technical stakeholders.

Thanks — looping in Karthik and Marissa to coordinate procurement/security artifacts and next steps.

Best,
Soojin

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-14T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: FolkHealth MAP tasks and owner checklist

Internal note — keeping this brief so we have clear owners for the asks: 

- Marissa: own SOC2 packet review and be ready for security call. Action: compile SOC2-OnePager + handoff to Security Eng for call. Due 4/16.
- Karthik (me): draft procurement SOW template + initial commercial terms; will attach to HubSpot deal. Due 4/20.
- Soojin: confirm econ buyer + confirm calendar for MVP scoping.

Related links: HubSpot deal RDW-2027-FOLK-0042 (https://hubspot.example/deal/12345) and MAP draft in Drive (https://drive.google.com/folkhealth/pocteam/Map_v1).

Will sync 4/15 10:00 for 15 minutes to make sure artifacts are ready.

—Karthik
From: Emma Barnes <emma.barnes@folkhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@folkhealth.com>, procurement@folkhealth.com
Date: 2027-04-19T09:13:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + draft alignment action plan for FolkHealth POC

Thanks everyone — confirming a few quick points: 

- I am the economic buyer and will sign off on the POC SOW once legal/procurement and security greenlight.
- Aisha (VP Product) will join the MVP scoping call.
- Procurement contact is procurement@folkhealth.com; they will expect the SOC2 one-pager and residency answers before we move forward.
- Proposed MVP scoping window 4/26 10:00–10:30 PT works for me and Aisha.

Next steps:
- Soojin / Redwood: deliver final SOC2 packet + residency confirmation by 4/16 (per MAP).
- Karthik: upload SOW template and target commercial terms to HubSpot by 4/20.
- FolkHealth procurement/legal: send initial redlines within 3–5 business days of receiving SOW.

Looking forward to the scoping call.

Best,
Emma
Director, Product & Partnerships
FolkHealth
